user_request: Read-only protocol spike. Drive the installed pi CLI in RPC mode (pi --mode rpc) as a child process and record what it really emits. Do not edit any repository source file; write only inside .planning/packets/claude-agent-sdk-pi-rpc/.
instructions: Protocol reference: $(npm root -g)/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/docs/rpc.md, rpc-commands.md, json.md and cli.md. Read ONLY those docs, not the repository. Write a small throwaway driver script inside the allowed directory (node or python3) that spawns pi --mode rpc with a --session-dir inside the allowed directory, writes JSONL commands to stdin and saves every stdout line. Use trivial prompts to keep token spend small (e.g. 'Reply with the single word ok', and 'Run the bash command: echo hi' for the tool call). Do not write to /tmp. Do not commit. If pi cannot start or has no usable model, stop and report BLOCKED with the stderr text.
